description: Photo gallery: one large featured image on the left, smaller images in a grid on the right (stacked on mobile).

visualCharacteristics.purpose: photo gallery for a tourist-place page

contentPattern.structure: images only, in any rows or cells (typically one row: featured image | further images). The first image is featured; the rest form the thumbnail grid. Text in an image's cell becomes its caption

reuseGuidance: Use for an image-only photo set. For text beside an image use columns.
